newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices mostly higher, Brazils down.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices mostly higher, Brazils down.

text.p: Brazil arabicas bucked a firmer price trend in the Bremen physical market and were marked down $2 per 50 kg fob on the week to $110.
Traders cited sellers' readiness to offer price concessions as business slowed in comparison with recent weeks.
Kenyan prices were up $1 at $158, expressing anticipated tightness in November/December.
Roasters needed to buy some spot arabicas for replacement cover, which sellers used to raise differentials.
Interest elsewhere focused on first half 1997 shipment.
Robusta prices eased further but buying was thin.
